reference_sql:
SELECT c.parent_category, COUNT(*) AS n_undercut_checks
FROM competitor_prices cp
JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = cp.product_id AND CAST(cp.observed_ts AS DATE) >= ph.valid_from AND (ph.valid_to IS NULL OR CAST(cp.observed_ts AS DATE) <= ph.valid_to)
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = cp.product_id
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE cp.observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01' AND cp.observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01' AND cp.price_eur < ph.list_price_eur
GROUP BY c.parent_category

SELECT c.parent_category, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cp.price_eur < ph.list_price_eur) AS n_undercut_checks FROM competitor_prices cp JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = cp.product_id AND CAST(cp.observed_ts AS DATE) >= ph.valid_from AND (ph.valid_to IS NULL OR CAST(cp.observed_ts AS DATE) <= ph.valid_to) JOIN products p ON p.product_id = cp.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE cp.observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01' AND cp.observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01' GROUP BY c.parent_category HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cp.price_eur < ph.list_price_eur) > 0

solver.query:
SELECT c.parent_category, COUNT(*) AS n_undercut_checks
FROM competitor_prices cp
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = cp.product_id
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN price_history h ON h.product_id = cp.product_id
  AND h.valid_from <= CAST(cp.observed_ts AS DATE)
  AND (h.valid_to IS NULL OR h.valid_to >= CAST(cp.observed_ts AS DATE))
WHERE cp.observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00' AND cp.observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
  AND cp.price_eur < h.list_price_eur
GROUP BY c.parent_category
